checks.name: Every main-section physical key has one placement
All five rows span exactly 15 units at the specified heights
Q A Z preserve ANSI row staggering
Wide keys use their centers rather than the left key position
Bottom row includes both modifier sides and the 6.25-unit space
A fresh press produces a center and six stars in the same update
The center rapidly grows while six stars spread in different directions
The center is gone after 100ms, while the six satellites remain
The final expiration requests one redraw to remove stale stars
An idle scene stops requesting keyboard redraws
Simultaneous keys burst at three independent physical positions
Holding does not repeat before 300ms
Holding at 300ms adds one smaller center and four stars
Subsequent repeat interval is 180ms
OS auto-repeat events do not add bursts or change the application rhythm
Release immediately stops births, and existing particles expire naturally
Snapshot cancels a hold even if its release event has aged out
Modifier sides each burst once; releases and holds never repeat
Unresolved modifier transitions are ignored
Caps Lock bursts on both toggles but not duplicate lock states
Keys outside the physical layout do not create particles
Listening midway through a hold never starts synthetic repeats
Event sequence cursor makes replaying a snapshot idempotent
Secure input preserves fading stars but cancels all holds across recovery
Recovery responds to fresh presses in the new generation
Permission loss, suspend, stop and reconnect cannot replay held keys
A long frame expires old particles and emits at most one current repeat
A fresh event after a stall is not aged by the preceding frame duration
Capacity recycles oldest bursts and never exceeds 16 bursts / 112 stars
All main-section bursts fit the canvas throughout their lifetime
The native session pipeline animates keyboard input without audio permission
Audio generation changes do not reset keyboard particles or hold rhythm
Keyboard repeat continues independently through audio reconnection
Hiding or disposing the module clears every burst
Resume with a held snapshot does not replay a hidden press
Settled audio and no stars stop display invalidation
